finalists.label: Subacute Cutaneous Lupus Erythematosus
finalists.why: It has specific findings such as symmetric annular brown erythematous plaques on the cheeks and temples and interface dermatitis.

finalists.label: Dermatomyositis
finalists.why: It has specific skin findings such as multiple millimetric erythematous to hyperpigmented monomorphic keratotic papules and symmetric annular brown erythematous plaques.

frontier_selector.why: The presence of specific skin findings such as symmetric annular brown erythematous plaques and interface dermatitis, along with the presence of anti-SSA/Ro antibodies, decided the final comparison in favor of Subacute Cutaneous Lupus Erythematosus.
